name: Netorare Osananajimi ~Saimin Nikubou Chuudoku~
original_name: 寝取られ幼馴染～催眠肉棒中毒～
source:

[Adapted from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE178328.html]DLsite English[/url]]
